root_cause: The Pikaday date picker's keyboard handler (_onKeyChange) does not handle the Tab key (keyCode 9). When a user types a date in the bound input field and presses Tab, the picker remains open and its focusable elements (day buttons, navigation buttons) intercept the Tab navigation, preventing focus from moving to the next form field.
repair_strategy: Add a case for keyCode 9 (Tab) in the _onKeyChange switch statement. When Tab is pressed while the bound input field is focused (e.target === opts.field), hide the picker to release its focus trap and allow the browser's default Tab behavior to move focus to the next form field.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now tab from the date input field to the next form field (guests) after typing a date, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Minimal - only affects Tab key behavior when the picker is visible and the input field is focused
Arrow key navigation within the picker remains unchanged
Date selection with Enter/Space still works
Picker closes on Tab from field as intended
verification_requirements: Tab from checkin field moves focus to guests field
